correctness.rationale: A genuine counterexample disproves a universal multiplier assertion in the original: n=1, y=1 has no one-cell predecessor but y^3=111 has input 001 on the 3-ring. Thus the original cannot PASS unchanged. The corrected RESULT.md explicitly isolates the singleton; on nonconstant outputs the XOR-boundary factorization y_i=d_{i-1} OR d_i and even cyclic parity prove the forced 2-run parity obstruction and exactly-even multiplier set. All-one length k>=2 is reachable (even k all-one boundary; odd k>=3 one zero boundary). The 4-state forbidden-word trace and signed cycle-block generating functions prove the unchanged R_n formula. I independently enumerated direct images to n=17 and checked all formulas, not inferring an infinite proof from them.

final_claim: Corrected Rule126 theorem: every nonconstant cyclic output avoiding 010 is same-period reachable iff one-runs have length >=2 and either one has length >=4 or the number of 2-runs is even. Nonconstant obstructed words lift exactly on even multiples. Singleton y=1 on n=1 fails at k=1 but lifts at every k>=2, including odd k. Exact rational R_n census and lambda^n-phi^n/2+O(1) remain unchanged.
